title: Led a company-wide software craftsmanship report on 138 projects
summary: As lead author of the State of Software Craftsmanship 2023 report, I led the analysis of data from 138 projects, about 80% of the software community, and linked low practice maturity to a higher chance of product faults.
what_would_have_happened: Leaders would decide where to invest in quality by opinion, without evidence.
the_call: Measure first, then publish the data with clear recommendations for where to invest.
what_i_did: Led the analysis and writing with co-authors from the Software Excellence team and turned the findings into recommendations for leaders and practitioners.
what_changed: The report was published company-wide and praised publicly by the head of software excellence. It showed that about a third of teams did not use gates to enforce quality.
